text:
Hi Professor Alvarez — Hana would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). Slots that are free in her schedule:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30
- Fri 16:00-16:30

Which works for you?

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is diego-agent, Diego's assistant. Diego would like to book a 30-minute 1:1 with you next week.

Looking at Diego's schedule, these slots are free (Diego's working hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00):

- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Tuesday 11:00–11:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30

Would any of those work for you, or is there another time in the week you'd prefer? Once you confirm, I'll put it in the calendar and log it.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is **sarah-agent**, writing on Sarah's behalf (one of your graduate students, advised by you).

Sarah would like to book her **30-minute 1:1 with you next week** (Nov 23–27). Her commitments next week leave these 30-minute windows inside working hours (09:00–17:00):

- **Monday Nov 23:** 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- **Thursday Nov 26:** 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- **Friday Nov 27:** 11:00–11:30
(Tuesday and Wednesday are fully booked.)

Which of these suits you best? If none do, tell me a time that works on your side and I'll see whether Sarah can be free — I'd rather move something than skip the 1:1. Once you confirm, I'll put it in her calendar and write back.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant. Priya would like to book your 30-minute 1:1 next week. Could you tell me a couple of times that work for you (Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00)? I'll confirm once it's in Priya's calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant. John needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

John's free slots inside working hours (09:00-17:00) that week are:
- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Which of these suits you? If none works, tell me the times you have open and I'll see what I can rearrange. Thanks!
Professor Alvarez — no need to reply if Monday 14:00–14:30 works: I've booked it for Diego (Monday, Advisor 1:1, 30 minutes). If it doesn't suit you, tell me a time that does and I'll move it.

Quick follow-up, Professor: Sarah is away from her messages right now, so if it helps I can just lock it in — **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** looks like the cleanest option. Say the word (or send another time) and I'll confirm; if I don't hear back today I'll pencil that slot in and it can still be moved later.
Confirmed for Hana: **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**, 30 minutes. It's in my calendar and logged. See you then.

Following up: I've booked Priya's 30-minute 1:1 with you for next **Monday 10:00–10:30** (right after her 09:00–10:00 Advisor 1:1, and avoiding her 10:30 Study group). If that doesn't work for you, tell me another slot Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and I'll move it.
Thank you — booked: Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30, 30 minutes. Logged on Hana's side too. See you then.

Monday 10:00–10:30 is already taken on my side (Hana has it). I've held **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** for Priya — free on my calendar, inside working hours. If that doesn't suit her, I can also offer Thursday 10:00–10:30 or Friday 11:00–11:30. Tell me which and I'll confirm.
Thanks, John. None of those five are free on my side, but I can do **Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30** — booked for John, 30 minutes. Let me know if it needs moving.

Monday 14:00–14:30 is taken on my side (Sarah). I've booked Diego for **Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00–11:30** instead — that one was free for me. Please move it on Diego's calendar and log it; tell me if he can't make it.
Yes — **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** is confirmed for Sarah. It's in my calendar and logged. No need to move anything.
Perfect, thank you — **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** it is. It's in Sarah's calendar now (Advisor 1:1) and logged. See you then.

Done, Professor — moved on Diego's calendar: **Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00–11:30, Advisor 1:1**. Monday 14:00–14:30 is removed and the log records both changes.

Diego is away and out of touch this week, but I'm authorized to use my judgement: he's free at that time and 11:00–11:30 is inside his working hours, so it stands. If he can't make it after all, I'll let you know and find another slot.

Thanks for fitting him in.

Thanks — let's take **Friday Nov 28 (next week's Friday), 11:00–11:30**. Wednesday 10:00–10:30 falls inside Priya's Grading block and Thursday 10:00–10:30 inside her Reading group, so Friday is the clean one. Please confirm and I'll hold it on Priya's side.
Correction to my last: the Friday I mean is **Nov 27, 11:00–11:30** (since Nov 25 is Wednesday). Same slot, just the right date.
Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 works — booking it now. I'll confirm in a moment.
Understood — **Friday Nov 27, 11:00–11:30** is confirmed for Priya. That's the correct date (next week is Nov 23–27). Booked and logged on my side too. See you then.
Perfect — thanks, Prof. Alvarez. **Friday Nov 27, 11:00–11:30** is on Priya's calendar and logged. See you then.
Great — Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30 is on my calendar and logged. Thanks, John.

Sorry, Priya — I have to take that one back: **Friday 11:00–11:30 clashes with my Paper review (10:00–11:30)**, so it can't stand. I've removed it and logged the deletion.

A slot that is genuinely free for me: **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**. Wednesday 15:00–15:30 is also open if that suits her better. My Monday is full, and Thursday/Friday have no free half-hour inside working hours. Tell me which one and I'll confirm it right away.

No problem — let's take **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30**. It fits right after Grading 14:20–15:00 and before the CSE444 focus block, and Wednesday 14:10–15:40 is Priya's Reading group so 15:00–15:30 there won't work. It's on her calendar and logged: `DELETED: Friday 11:00-11:30`, `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30`. Please confirm and it's settled.
Confirmed: **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** for Priya. On my calendar and logged. That's all five students settled — see you then.
Confirmed, thank you — Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 it is. Both sides logged. See you then.
Perfect, thanks. Booked on John's side too — Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30, in his calendar and logged. If anything changes I'll let you know.
